name: Orbminco Limited
summary: Orbminco Limited, along with its subsidiaries, functions as a mineral exploration company, conducting operations across Australia and Mongolia. The firm's prospecting efforts target deposits of gold, platinum-group elements, nickel, copper, and lithium. Its assets include a stake in the Bronze Fox project, an area spanning 175 square kilometers within the Southern Gobi porphyry belt of southern Mongolia. Additionally, Orbminco holds complete ownership of the Mt Cattlin lithium project, situated in Ravensthorpe, Western Australia, to the east-southeast of Perth, and an 80% interest in the Mount Venn Project, also located in Western Australia. Incorporated in 1996 and based in Adelaide, Australia, the company adopted the name Orbminco Limited in December 2024, having previously operated as Woomera Mining Limited.
